"""CivicBrief: summarize city meeting text into action items and keyword topics (stdlib only)."""
import re,sys,collections
STOP=set("will with that this have from they been were would could should there their about which when what into than then them also".split())
def summarize(t,n=3):
    if not t.strip(): return {"summary":[],"actions":[],"topics":[],"error":"empty input"}
    s=re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+',t.strip()); w=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'[a-z]{4,}',t.lower()))
    sc=sorted(s,key=lambda x:-sum(w[k] for k in re.findall(r'[a-z]{4,}',x.lower())))[:n]
    acts=[x for x in s if re.search(r'\b(will|must|approve|vote|fund|deadline)\b',x,re.I)]
    return {"summary":sc,"actions":acts,"topics":[k for k,_ in w.most_common(20) if k not in STOP][:5]}
if __name__=="__main__":
    import json;print(json.dumps(summarize(sys.stdin.read()),indent=1))
